help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Enhances the to hit debuff potential of a power by {Boost.Attrib.ToHitDebuff.Scale}% and the defense debuff potential and slow ability by {Boost.Attrib.DefenseDebuff.Scale}%, reduces the endurance cost of the power by {Boost.Attrib.Endurance.Scale}% and reduces recharge time by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}%.
power_short_helps: Enhances To Hit and Defense Debuffs and Slows, Reduces Endurance Cost, and Increases Attack Rate
